dedupe_keys.name: employment land supply scotland spatial hub

description: This Spatial Hub dataset brings together the employment land audits of Scottish local authorities into one national layer. Under Scottish Planning Policy, each audit monitors the supply, take-up and status of land allocated for business and industry, assesses the range and choice of marketable sites for businesses of different size and quality needs, and records the availability and constraints of each employment land site. The Improvement Service publishes an open version, whose licence is listed as "Open" on the Spatial Hub, and a premium version, and serves the layer as a WFS; a WFS request from this session returned HTTP 403, so the attribute fields could not be checked. The entry is updated annually and was last revised on 30 July 2026. Coverage is Scotland, assembled from council audits. Caveats: audit methods and dates differ between councils, and the fields of the open and premium versions are not stated on the page read. For simulation it shows where industrial and business land is available or being taken up, useful for siting new industrial demand in energy, water and transport capacity planning. Related catalogue records include the BGS Mineral Planning Permissions data and the UK mineral processing facilities dataset.
